40.t: 5-2-2. Game Adjustments
1. Open the coin door and slide the test switch “ON” while pressing the Enter button. (The game will only enter the Game Adjustment mode when it is in the
Attract Mode.)
2. Pressing the Enter Switch will step through the tests. Pressing the Service Switch will change the setting.
3. After adjustment is completed, slide the test switch to the “OFF” position to return to normal game mode.
